sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 876)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across three distinct eras of Rudy Vallee's broadcasting career (*The Witch* with Ilka Chase in 1934; seasonal audition with Xavier Cugat in 1944; Villa Vallee nightclub quiz with Sweeney & March in 1945), Johnny Mercer and Jo Stafford on *Johnny Mercer's Music Shop* for Pepsodent (1944), New Orleans Dixieland masters on *This Is Jazz* hosted by Rudi Blesh (1947), and daytime drama with Virginia Payne on *Ma Perkins* (1949).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
